propositions: Function-scoped rebar_repo fixture incurs 306ms per test via git init/config/commit spawns, consuming 47% of tier wall-clock (361.4s setup / 391.0s call); session-scoped template with per-test copytree reduces to 22.3ms (13.7x speedup)

Worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and gitdir file) embed absolute template paths; a bare `git worktree repair` on a copy silently corrupts the source, so both files must be rewritten against copy realpath and validated via `git worktree list --porcelain`
Snapshot store keys by commit SHA alone; one template shared across 150+ tests causes LRU collisions and races; each test must receive unique REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR

Environment identity files (.env-id, .signing-key) are copied verbatim by copytree; they must be unconditionally regenerated per test to preserve uniqueness and prevent undetected signature/identity leakage across workers
Module-global _pending_cache in ensures.py is PATH-keyed and safe with per-test copies, but requires explicit reset to prevent future re-keying from creating worker-wide state leaks across 589 tests

Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context (REBAR_ROOT set, XDG_CONFIG_HOME cleared, config env vars deleted) to prevent first-requester ambient environment from being baked into template and copied to all 589 tests
